schemaVersion.description: Increment this whenever the structure of a gemstone object changes in a breaking way, so the app can detect and handle old vs new formats.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last edit. The app compares this to its locally cached copy to decide whether to re-download.

id.description: Stable, URL-safe slug used as the primary key (local DB row id, favorites, deep links). Never reuse or repurpose once published.

category.description: Mineral family or group, e.g. Quartz, Beryl, Corundum, Organic/Mineraloid.

shortDescription.description: One or two sentence summary shown in the list view.

description.description: Full text shown on the detail screen.

hardness.description: Mohs scale value or range as a display string, e.g. '7' or '6.5–7.5'.

imageUrl.description: URL to a representative photo. Host images on a CDN or static host alongside the JSON.

localities.description: Countries or regions where the gemstone is commonly found.

imageAttribution.description: Photo credit, if required by the image's license.

tags.description: Free-form keywords for search/filtering in the app, e.g. 'birthstone', 'quartz-family'.
